model_output.verdict: A store manager with strong sales, turnover and shrink figures, but only one turnaround detailed.
write_up: You look like a store manager who knows the numbers and the floor. The headline promises two turnarounds, though the work section gives the detail for only one.
The turnover line is the model: it names the change you made and the move from 68% to 41%. The sales, customer satisfaction and shrink figures make the current store easy to understand, too.
